implementation: Structured lane selection receives the existing collection_jobs_remaining checkpoint value. It picks recent overlap on two of each three available slots and history on the third, while preserving oldest-attempt fairness within the selected subset. Direct calls without a valid budget prefer pending recent lanes; after recent completion, pending lanes resume the existing fair selection.

The Austin fixture now has 1,201 count-checked current rows, with the dense modified-date overlap split across two bounded date ranges. It verifies both current recent lanes complete within an eight-job budget and history completed_through advances.

RSS normalization converts list-compatible snapshots to plain normalized lists. The original snapshot is now retained as metadata input when writing a successful checkpoint, preserving ETag and Last-Modified, including for an empty complete snapshot. Partial normalization still does not advance validators because the checkpoint call remains in the full-success branch.

The first passing liveness result reopened an already advanced history window later in the chain, so its current status was incomplete even though completed_through advanced. The assertion now checks the packet requirement, actual advancement, instead of requiring history to stay complete.
